source.paper: Shaffer et al. 2017 melanoma rare-cell variability and drug-induced reprogramming

bio_chi_event.phenomenon: transcriptomic recovery versus reorganization during a source-defined drug holiday
bio_chi_event.baseline: source-defined NoDrug state for the same subclone
bio_chi_event.primary_question: After drug removal, does each source-defined subclone move back toward its own NoDrug transcriptomic state by day 7?

expression_processing.gene_filter: CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of the 18 unique frozen samples

whole_event_primary.distance: 1 - Pearson correlation to same-subclone NoDrug baseline
whole_event_primary.carrier_aggregation: mean each distance across same-subclone lanes before primary gate
whole_event_primary.primary_gate: all three subclones have mean holiday7 distance < mean drug distance
whole_event_primary.exact_sign_test: one-sided across 3 subclones; p=0.125 if all three improve; resolution diagnostic only
whole_event_primary.temporal_secondary: report whether holiday48 improves versus drug and whether holiday7 improves versus holiday48 for each lane and carrier; not required for primary pass

whole_event_sensitivity.distance: Euclidean after per-gene z-scaling across the 18 frozen samples; remove zero-variance genes
whole_event_sensitivity.role: directional robustness only; no independent promotion

modal_gate.basis: centered SVD/PCA of the 18 frozen logCPM samples; no outcome labels used to fit basis
modal_gate.retention: minimum leading PCs explaining at least 80% cumulative variance
modal_gate.distance: Euclidean distance in retained-PC score space to same-subclone NoDrug baseline
modal_gate.modal_return_gate: all three subclones have mean day-7 modal distance < mean drug modal distance
modal_gate.direction_metric: cosine between Drug-to-day7 displacement and Drug-to-baseline target vector in retained-PC space
modal_gate.interpretation_if_whole_event_pass_modal: global transcriptomic recovery with modal reorganization/non-restoration
modal_gate.interpretation_if_both_pass: recovery includes return in the frozen retained modal representation

scalar_gate.reason: No source-native continuous-time generator is established for this holiday RNA state-space; static PCA does not license scalar construction.

pseudoreplication_control: Five wells are descriptive lanes nested within three subclones; subclone is the primary directional carrier.
claim_ceiling: P0-Q within-source recovery/reorganization qualification; no independent held-out behavior lane exists in this frozen branch.
